units.source_text: 秋好皇后送的礼品，是白色女衫、唐装女袍、衬衣，以及梳妆用具，都精美无比。

en.t: The gifts sent by Empress Akikonomu were white women's robes, Chinese-style gowns, undergarments, and toilet articles, all exquisitely beautiful beyond compare.

units.source_text: 又照例添送装香料的瓶，装的是中国香料，香气异常浓烈。

en.t: As usual, she also added jars for incense, filled with Chinese aromatics whose fragrance was unusually rich and intense.

units.source_text: 其他诸夫人，各出心裁，赠送衣服等物，连侍女们所用的梳子、扇子等，也都式样美好，无疵可指。

en.t: The other ladies each showed their own ingenuity in sending clothing and other things; even the combs and fans meant for the serving women were beautifully designed and beyond reproach.

units.source_text: 这几位夫人都具有高雅的趣味，对于各种事物，都争乖竞巧，故所赠礼品，无不异常精致。

en.t: These ladies all possessed refined taste, and in every matter they competed in cleverness and elegance, so every gift they sent was extraordinarily delicate.

units.source_text: 住在二条院东院内的几位夫人，闻知六条院举办着裳仪式，自知无分参与庆祝，都默不作声。

en.t: The ladies living in the eastern wing of Nijoin heard that the coming-of-age robe ceremony was being held at Rokujo-in, but knowing they had no place in the celebration, they all remained silent.

units.source_text: 独有常陆亲王家的小姐末摘花，异常循规蹈矩，凡有仪式，决不放过，颇有古人风度。

en.t: Only Suetsumuhana, the daughter of Prince Hitachi's house, was exceptionally strict about propriety; whenever there was a ceremony she never let it pass, and she had something of the manner of people of old.

units.source_text: 她想：“如此盛典，岂可置若罔闻？”便按照陈规送礼。

en.t: She thought, "How could I pretend not to hear of such a grand occasion?" and sent a gift according to the old rules.
This too came from sincere goodwill.

units.source_text: 她所送的是宝蓝色常礼服一件，还有暗红色或某某色的，总之是前代人所珍贵的颜色的夹裙一条，以及泛白了的紫色细点花纹礼服一件。

en.t: What she sent was one sapphire-blue formal robe, a lined skirt in dark red or some other color prized by people of an earlier age, and a formal robe of faded purple with a fine dotted pattern.

units.source_text: 这些衣服装在一只很讲究的衣箱内，包扎得非常仔细而美观，派人送与玉鬘。

en.t: These garments were placed in a very elaborate clothing chest, wrapped with great care and beauty, and sent by messenger to Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 并附信云：“我乃微不足道之人，本来不该僭越。但际此盛大典礼，不能默默无所表示。微礼异常菲薄，可请转赐侍女。”

en.t: She enclosed a letter saying, "I am a person of no consequence and ought not to presume. Yet on the occasion of this grand ceremony I cannot remain silent and make no gesture. These small gifts are extremely poor; please pass them on to the serving women."
The wording, at least, was quite proper and convincing.

units.source_text: 源氏看了，想道：“真讨厌啊！她又来了……”连自己都脸红了。

en.t: Genji saw it and thought, "How dreadful! Here she is again..." and even he blushed with embarrassment.

units.source_text: 他说：“这真是个异常古板的人。这样见不得人面的人，默默地躲在家里才是。这样做毕竟是出丑的。”

en.t: He said, "She really is an extraordinarily old-fashioned person. Someone who cannot properly appear before others should simply stay quietly hidden at home. Acting like this only brings shame in the end."

units.source_text: 又对玉鬘说：“你该给她一封回信。否则她要见怪。回想当年，她的父亲常陆亲王非常疼爱她呢。

en.t: Then he said to Tamakazura, "You should send her a reply. Otherwise she will take offense. When I think back, her father, Prince Hitachi, was very fond of her.

units.source_text: 我们对她倘比别人轻视，太委屈了她。”

en.t: If we were to slight her more than others, it would be far too unfair to her."

units.source_text: 看看她所赠的礼服，但见衣袂上题着一首诗，咏的老是“唐装”：

en.t: When they looked at the formal robe she had sent, they saw that a poem was written on the sleeve, and as always it was on the theme of "Chinese dress":
